title: Dengue virus controlled human challenge reveals that preexisting immunity shapes viral replication and broadly protective responses
abstract: Dengue is the canonical viral disease for which immune history is a determinant of protective versus pathogenic responses and immunogenicity. Yet, because of limitations in animal models and clinical presentation after peak viremia, how preinfection and early immune responses affect dengue outcome is not confirmed. We conducted a phase 1 clinical trial with 45 healthy adults to test whether secondary infection challenge with a heterotypic, full-length, attenuated virus increases viremia and immunogenicity compared with primary and tertiary infection. Viremia was associated with more, but still mild, clinical signs and symptoms, and secondary infection resulted in greater viremia, neutralizing antibodies, and protective T cell responses. However, those whose baseline antibodies most efficiently increased dengue virus replication in an in vitro assay experienced delayed inflammatory and adaptive immune activation, the highest viremia, strong acute immune responses, and waning of potent CD8 + T cells and antibodies. In contrast, higher baseline antibodies against the nonstructural protein 1 of multiple serotypes predicted early interferon and balanced immune activation, viremia control, and development of enduring, potent B and T cells, revealing how vaccines can induce broad, long-lasting protection. Last, individuals with potent and neutralizing antibodies and IFN-γ + T cells at baseline experienced minimal viral replication. Together, these findings demonstrate that controlled human challenge with dengue virus can delineate coordinated versus dysregulated acute immune responses and their effects on immunogenicity, informing therapeutic and vaccine strategies for dengue and other viral diseases.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to investigate how preexisting immunity influences dengue virus replication and immune responses. A phase 1 clinical trial with 45 healthy adults was conducted to compare outcomes of secondary infection challenge with a heterotypic, full-length, attenuated virus against primary and tertiary infections. The results showed that secondary infection led to greater viremia, neutralizing antibodies, and protective T cell responses. However, individuals with baseline antibodies that efficiently increased viral replication in vitro experienced delayed immune activation, high viremia, and waning of CD8+ T cells and antibodies. Higher baseline antibodies against nonstructural protein 1 of multiple serotypes were linked to early interferon responses, balanced immune activation, and viremia control. The study highlights the importance of preexisting immunity in shaping dengue outcomes and suggests that vaccines could induce broad, long-lasting protection. The findings demonstrate that controlled human challenge with dengue virus can help distinguish coordinated from dysregulated immune responses, offering insights for therapeutic and vaccine strategies. The evidence is strong, but the study's design and limited sample size may affect generalizability.

title_zh: 登革病毒 人体受控挑战试验揭示了既往免疫力如何塑造病毒复制和广泛保护性免疫应答
source_body_en: Dengue is the canonical viral disease for which immune history is a determinant of protective versus pathogenic responses and immunogenicity. abstract_zh: 登革热是典型的病毒性疾病,其免疫史决定了保护性与致病性免疫应答及免疫原性。然而,由于动物模型和临床表现的局限性,尤其是在病毒血症高峰期之后,既往感染和早期 免疫应答 对登革热结果的影响尚未得到确认。我们开展了一项 I 期临床试验,纳入 45 名健康成年人,以测试与初次和三次感染相比,异型、全长、减毒病毒的二次感染挑战是否能增加病毒血症和免疫原性。病毒血症与更多但仍然轻微的临床症状相关,而二次感染导致更高的病毒血症、中和抗体水平和保护性 T 细胞应答。然而,那些基线抗体在体外试验中最有效地促进 登革病毒 复制的个体表现出延迟的炎症和适应性免疫激活、最高的病毒血症、强烈的急性 免疫应答 以及强效 CD8 + T 细胞和抗体的减弱。相反,对多种血清型非结构蛋白 1 具有较高基线抗体水平的个体则预测了早期干扰素产生、平衡的免疫激活、病毒血症控制以及持久且强效的 B 细胞和 T 细胞的发育,揭示了 疫苗 如何诱导广泛而持久的保护。最后,那些基线具有强效且中和抗体以及 IFN-γ + T 细胞的个体表现出最小的病毒复制。综上所述,这些发现表明,通过 登革病毒 进行的人体受控挑战试验能够区分急性 免疫应答 的协调与失调状态及其对免疫原性的影响,从而为登革热及其他病毒性疾病提供治疗和 疫苗 策略的依据。

title: Metabolic Screening and In Silico Investigation of Eucalyptus globulus Essential Oil Bioactives Against DENV-2 Envelope Protein.
abstract: The escalating prevalence of viral infectious diseases poses a significant threat to global public health. Among these, dengue virus (DENV) represents one of the most widespread arboviral infections, impacting nearly 400 million individuals annually, with severe clinical manifestations occurring in approximately 1% of cases, as reported by the World Health Organization (WHO). Extensive research across both academic and industrial sectors has focused on various aspects of DENV, including its molecular virology, epidemiological patterns, transmission pathways, and therapeutic targets. The development of the tetravalent CYD-TDV (Dengvaxia) vaccine marked a critical advancement in dengue prevention. Nonetheless, emerging evidence has highlighted several limitations associated with current vaccination strategies, prompting a growing emphasis on the discovery and development of antiviral agents as alternative or complementary therapeutic options for effective dengue management. A total of 14 major bioactive compounds were found to be highly correlated with Dengue, yielding 70 common targets between dengue and bioactive compounds. Protein-protein interaction and network pathway analysis by KEGG and Metascape analysis show higher degree of correlation for DENV-2 targets. Molecular docking analysis shows that Globulol and Ecalyptol have higher binding affinity with two receptors, 1oke and 1tg8 f DENV-2, with binding energies of -8.3 and -7.6. Toxicity and drug-likeness analyses confirmed the safety of the metabolites for drug development. These findings suggest that Eucalyptus globulus essential oil may have potential in the treatment of dengue fever. However, further in vivo studies using animal models are required to validate its therapeutic efficacy.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The escalating prevalence of viral infectious diseases poses a significant threat to global public health. Among these, dengue virus (DENV) represents one of the most widespread arboviral infections, impacting nearly 400 million individuals annually, with severe clinical manifestations occurring in approximately 1% of cases, as reported by the World Health Organization (WHO).
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on the molecular docking analysis of Eucalyptus globulus essential oil bioactives against DENV-2 envelope protein. It involved the identification of bioactive compounds and their interaction with DENV-2 targets.
analysis.methods: The study employed metabolic screening and in silico investigation techniques, including protein-protein interaction and network pathway analysis by KEGG and Metascape, as well as molecular docking analysis to assess binding affinity with DENV-2 receptors.
analysis.main_results: A total of 14 major bioactive compounds were found to be highly correlated with Dengue, yielding 70 common targets between dengue and bioactive compounds. Protein-protein interaction and network pathway analysis by KEGG and Metascape analysis show higher degree of correlation for DENV-2 targets. Molecular docking analysis shows that Globulol and Ecalyptol have higher binding affinity with two receptors, 1oke and 1tg8 f DENV-2, with binding energies of -8.3 and -7.6.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: These findings suggest that Eucalyptus globulus essential oil may have potential in the treatment of dengue fever. The development of the tetravalent CYD-TDV (Dengvaxia) vaccine marked a critical advancement in dengue prevention.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform the development of antiviral agents as alternative or complementary therapeutic options for effective dengue management. The study highlights the potential of natural bioactives in targeting DENV-2 for therapeutic applications.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report in vivo studies or clinical trials to validate the therapeutic efficacy of Eucalyptus globulus essential oil. The evidence is based on in silico analysis, which may have limitations in predicting real-world outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the potential of Eucalyptus globulus essential oil bioactives against DENV-2 envelope protein through in silico methods. The research aimed to address the limitations of current dengue prevention strategies by exploring alternative therapeutic options. The findings revealed that Globulol and Ecalyptol exhibited higher binding affinity with DENV-2 receptors, suggesting their potential as antiviral agents. However, the study lacked in vivo validation, limiting the strength of the evidence. The results may contribute to the development of new treatments for dengue fever, particularly in the context of improving therapeutic options beyond existing vaccines.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: The escalating prevalence of viral infectious diseases poses a significant threat to global public health. Among these, dengue virus (DENV) represents one of the most widespread arboviral infections, impacting nearly 400 million individuals annually, with severe clinical manifestations occurring in approximately 1% of cases, as reported by the World Health Organization (WHO).
elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study focused on the molecular docking analysis of Eucalyptus globulus essential oil bioactives against DENV-2 envelope protein. It involved the identification of bioactive compounds and their interaction with DENV-2 targets.
elements_en.methods: The study employed metabolic screening and in silico investigation techniques, including protein-protein interaction and network pathway analysis by KEGG and Metascape, as well as molecular docking analysis to assess binding affinity with DENV-2 receptors.
elements_en.main_results: A total of 14 major bioactive compounds were found to be highly correlated with Dengue, yielding 70 common targets between dengue and bioactive compounds. Protein-protein interaction and network pathway analysis by KEGG and Metascape analysis show higher degree of correlation for DENV-2 targets. Molecular docking analysis shows that Globulol and Ecalyptol have higher binding affinity with two receptors, 1oke and 1tg8 f DENV-2, with binding energies of -8.3 and -7.6.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: These findings suggest that Eucalyptus globulus essential oil may have potential in the treatment of dengue fever. The development of the tetravalent CYD-TDV (Dengvaxia) vaccine marked a critical advancement in dengue prevention.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform the development of antiviral agents as alternative or complementary therapeutic options for effective dengue management. The study highlights the potential of natural bioactives in targeting DENV-2 for therapeutic applications.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report in vivo studies or clinical trials to validate the therapeutic efficacy of Eucalyptus globulus essential oil. The evidence is based on in silico analysis, which may have limitations in predicting real-world outcomes.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: The escalating prevalence of viral infectious diseases poses a significant threat to global public health. Among these, dengue virus (DENV) represents one of the most widespread arboviral infections, impacting nearly 400 million individuals annually, with severe clinical manifestations occurring in approximately 1% of cases, as reported by the World Health Organization (WHO).
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究聚焦于桉树精油生物活性成分与DENV-2包膜蛋白的分子对接分析。研究涉及生物活性成分的识别及其与DENV-2靶点的相互作用。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究采用了代谢筛选和计算机模拟技术,包括通过KEGG和Metascape进行的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用及网络通路分析,以及分子对接分析以评估其与DENV-2受体的结合亲和力。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现共有14种主要的生物活性成分与登革热高度相关,产生了70个登革热与生物活性成分之间的共同靶点。通过KEGG和Metascape分析进行的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用及网络通路分析显示,DENV-2靶点具有更高的相关性。分子对接分析表明,Globulol和Ecalyptol与DENV-2的两个受体1oke和1tg8具有更高的结合亲和力,结合能量分别为-8.3和-7.6。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,桉树精油可能在登革热的治疗中具有潜力。四价CYD-TDV(Dengvaxia)疫苗的开发标志着登革热预防的重要进展。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为开发抗病毒药物作为登革热管理的替代或补充治疗方案提供信息。本研究突出了天然生物活性成分在针对DENV-2进行治疗应用中的潜力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告使用动物模型进行的体内研究或临床试验以验证桉树精油的治疗效果。这些证据基于计算机模拟分析,可能在预测实际结果方面存在局限性。

title_zh: 桉树精油生物活性成分对DENV-2包膜蛋白的代谢筛选与计算机模拟研究
source_body_en: The escalating prevalence of viral infectious diseases poses a significant threat to global public health. Among these, dengue virus (DENV) represents one of the most widespread arboviral infections, impacting nearly 400 million individuals annually, with severe clinical manifestations occurring in approximately 1% of cases, as reported by the World Health Organization (WHO). Extensive research across both academic and industrial sectors has focused on various aspects of DENV, including its molecular virology, epidemiological patterns, transmission pathways, and therapeutic targets. The development of the tetravalent CYD-TDV (Dengvaxia) vaccine marked a critical advancement in dengue prevention. Nonetheless, emerging evidence has highlighted several limitations associated with current vaccination strategies, prompting a growing emphasis on the discovery and development of antiviral agents as alternative or complementary therapeutic options for effective dengue management. A total of 14 major bioactive compounds were found to be highly correlated with Dengue, yielding 70 common targets between dengue and bioactive compounds. Protein-protein interaction and network pathway analysis by KEGG and Metascape analysis show higher degree of correlation for DENV-2 targets. Molecular docking analysis shows that Globulol and Ecalyptol have higher binding affinity with two receptors, 1oke and 1tg8 f DENV-2, with binding energies of -8.3 and -7.6. Toxicity and drug-likeness analyses confirmed the safety of the metabolites for drug development. These findings suggest that Eucalyptus globulus essential oil may have potential in the treatment of dengue fever. However, further in vivo studies using animal models are required to validate its therapeutic efficacy.

title: Regional and Temporal Dynamics of Dengue in Mexico (2020-2024): A Comprehensive Epidemiological Analysis.
abstract: Dengue remains a major public health concern in Mexico, with incidence and clinical burden increasing substantially in recent years. Using national surveillance data from 2020 to 2024, this study provides a comprehensive overview of the changing epidemiological landscape, with an emphasis on geographic distribution, temporal trends, serotype dynamics, and disease severity. Over this period, Mexico saw an almost fivefold increase in dengue cases, reaching over 123,000 confirmed infections and 426 deaths in 2024, the highest annual number recorded. Seasonal patterns shifted, with sustained transmission extending into unusual winter months from late 2023. Serotyping data revealed a shift in predominant virus serotypes, with DENV2 predominating until 2022, DENV1 peaking in 2021, and DENV3 rising sharply from 2022 onward, becoming dominant in 2023 and almost exclusive by 2024. This shift coincided with a sustained rise in dengue with warning signs (from 16.9% in 2020 to > 42% in 2023-2024) and higher hospitalisation rates, while severe dengue remained below 5%. Although DENV3 dominated nationally, DENV1 and DENV2 persisted in specific states, and DENV4 circulated sporadically, particularly in southern and northern regions. Several traditionally low-prevalence states experienced atypical outbreaks, underscoring the potential for sudden epidemic expansion. Climatic analysis showed a consistent positive association between temperature and DENV3 prevalence, with precipitation effects varying by year. Odds ratio analysis suggested serotype-specific differences in severity across years. These findings underscore the heterogeneous and dynamic nature of dengue transmission in Mexico and highlight the need for regional surveillance, prevention, and clinical preparedness strategies.

abstract_zh: 登革热仍然是墨西哥的主要公共卫生问题,近年来其流行程度和临床负担显著增加。本研究利用2020年至2024年的全国登革热数据,全面概述了登革热流行病学景观的变化,重点分析了地理分布、时间趋势、血清型动态以及疾病严重程度。在这一时期,墨西哥的登革热病例数几乎增加了五倍,2024年达到超过123,000例确诊病例和426例死亡,这是有记录以来最高的年度病例数。季节性模式发生了变化,持续的登革热传播从2023年底延伸到了不寻常的冬季月份。血清型数据揭示了主要病毒血清型的变化,DENV2在2022年之前占主导地位,DENV1在2021年达到高峰,而DENV3则从2022年开始急剧上升,成为2023年的主导血清型,并在2024年几乎成为唯一流行的血清型。这种变化与登革热病例数的持续上升以及警告信号的增加(从2020年的16.9%上升到2023-2024年的>42%)相吻合,同时医院入院率也显著提高,而重症登革热病例仍低于5%。尽管DENV3在全国范围内占主导地位,但DENV1和DENV2在某些州仍持续存在,而DENV4则在南部和北部地区偶有流行。一些传统上登革热流行率较低的州出现了非典型的流行模式,突显了登革热暴发可能突然扩展的潜在风险。气候分析显示,温度与DENV3的流行率之间存在一致的正相关关系,而降水的影响则因年份而异。比值比分析表明,不同血清型在不同年份的严重程度存在差异。这些发现突显了墨西哥登革热传播模式的异质性和动态性,并强调了制定区域性监测、预防和临床准备策略的必要性。

title: Epidemiological, clinical, and diagnostic characteristics of a large-scale upsurge of dengue in the rohingya refugee camps and host communities in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, 2021 to 2024: A retrospective study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue emerged as a new public health threat in the Rohingya refugee camps in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, in 2021 and expanded into large-scale upsurges in subsequent years. Evidence on dengue epidemiology and clinical presentation in protracted refugee settings remains limited, despite the need for stronger outbreak preparedness and case management in these contexts. OBJECTIVES: To describe the epidemiological, clinical, and diagnostic characteristics of the dengue upsurge among Rohingya refugees and surrounding host communities in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, and to identify predictors of inpatient admission and diagnostic positivity patterns. METHODS: This retrospective observational study used anonymized surveillance data from the International Organization for Migration (IOM) dengue patient database. Rapid diagnostic test (RDT)-confirmed dengue cases identified across 36 IOM-supported health facilities in Ukhiya and Teknaf between 1 October 2021 and 31 December 2024 were included. Demographic, epidemiological, clinical, and laboratory variables were summarized using descriptive statistics. Weekly case counts were aggregated by epidemiological week and calendar year, and epidemic growth and decay phases were modelled using phase-specific Poisson regression. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with inpatient admission, while separate models examined associations between delay in presentation and RDT positivity patterns, adjusting for age and sex. RESULTS: A total of 35,581 RDT-confirmed dengue cases were reported, of which 90.2% occurred among Rohingya refugees. The median age was 17 years (IQR 7-30), and 46.0% of cases were among children aged 0-14 years. Annual caseload increased from 1,011 in 2021-11,752 in 2022, 10,669 in 2023 and 12,149 in 2024, with seasonal peaks during the monsoon period and progressively later peaks and longer epidemic tails over time. Poisson models showed decreasing growth rates across years (r = 0.449 in 2021 to r = 0.091 in 2024) with increasing doubling times, while decay rates remained broadly comparable (halving time ~4.4-6.0 weeks). Overall, 8.0% of cases required inpatient admission, 1.3% were referred, and four deaths were reported (case fatality <0.1%). In multivariable analysis, inpatient admission was associated with older age (≥60 vs 0-14: aOR 2.48), delayed presentation (aOR 1.06 per day), refugee status (aOR 1.43), fever ≥38°C at presentation (aOR 1.13), presence of any WHO warning sign (aOR 28.87), and chronic co-morbidity (aOR 6.63). Males had lower odds of admission than females (aOR 0.87). CONCLUSION: Sustained dengue preparedness is required in Cox's Bazar, including strengthened surveillance, community-based early referral, targeted monitoring of high-risk groups, environmental vector control, and phase-appropriate use of NS1 and IgM/IgG diagnostics to reduce missed diagnoses and prevent progression to severe disease. These findings highlight the need for a policy shift from episodic outbreak response toward sustained dengue preparedness in humanitarian settings, including strengthened surveillance systems, integrated diagnostic strategies, community-based early referral, and coordinated vector control interventions.
authors: Abu Toha M. R. H. Bhuiyan

analysis_en.main_results: A total of 35,581 RDT-confirmed dengue cases were reported, of which 90.2% occurred among Rohingya refugees. Overall, 8.0% of cases required inpatient admission, 1.3% were referred, and four deaths were reported (case fatality <0.1%).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as highlighting the need for sustained dengue preparedness in Cox's Bazar, including strengthened surveillance, community-based early referral, targeted monitoring of high-risk groups, environmental vector control, and phase-appropriate use of NS1 and IgM/IgG diagnostics to reduce missed diagnoses and prevent progression to severe disease.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings highlight the need for a policy shift from episodic outbreak response toward sustained dengue preparedness in humanitarian settings, including strengthened surveillance systems, integrated diagnostic strategies, community-based early referral, and coordinated vector control interventions.

title_zh: 孟加拉国库克斯巴扎尔罗兴亚难民营及宿主社区2021年至2024年登革热大规模暴发的流行病学、临床和诊断特征:一项回顾性研究。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue emerged as a new public health threat in the Rohingya refugee camps in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, in 2021 and expanded into large-scale upsurges in subsequent years. Evidence on dengue epidemiology and clinical presentation in protracted refugee settings remains limited, despite the need for stronger outbreak preparedness and case management in these contexts. OBJECTIVES: To describe the epidemiological, clinical, and diagnostic characteristics of the dengue upsurge among Rohingya refugees and surrounding host communities in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh, and to identify predictors of inpatient admission and diagnostic positivity patterns. METHODS: This retrospective observational study used anonymized surveillance data from the International Organization for Migration (IOM) dengue patient database. Rapid diagnostic test (RDT)-confirmed dengue cases identified across 36 IOM-supported health facilities in Ukhiya and Teknaf between 1 October 2021 and 31 December 2024 were included. Demographic, epidemiological, clinical, and laboratory variables were summarized using descriptive statistics. Weekly case counts were aggregated by epidemiological week and calendar year, and epidemic growth and decay phases were modelled using phase-specific Poisson regression. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with inpatient admission, while separate models examined associations between delay in presentation and RDT positivity patterns, adjusting for age and sex. RESULTS: A total of 35,581 RDT-confirmed dengue cases were reported, of which 90.2% occurred among Rohingya refugees. The median age was 17 years (IQR 7-30), and 46.0% of cases were among children aged 0-14 years. Annual caseload increased from 1,011 in 2021-11,752 in 2022, 10,669 in 2023 and 12,149 in 2024, with seasonal peaks during the monsoon period and progressively later peaks and longer epidemic tails over time. Poisson models showed decreasing growth rates across years (r = 0.449 in 2021 to r = 0.091 in 2024) with increasing doubling times, while decay rates remained broadly comparable (halving time ~4.4-6.0 weeks). Overall, 8.0% of cases required inpatient admission, 1.3% were referred, and four deaths were reported (case fatality <0.1%). In multivariable analysis, inpatient admission was associated with older age (≥60 vs 0-14: aOR 2.48), delayed presentation (aOR 1.06 per day), refugee status (aOR 1.43), fever ≥38°C at presentation (aOR 1.13), presence of any WHO warning sign (aOR 28.87), and chronic co-morbidity (aOR 6.63). Males had lower odds of admission than females (aOR 0.87). CONCLUSION: Sustained dengue preparedness is required in Cox's Bazar, including strengthened surveillance, community-based early referral, targeted monitoring of high-risk groups, environmental vector control, and phase-appropriate use of NS1 and IgM/IgG diagnostics to reduce missed diagnoses and prevent progression to severe disease. These findings highlight the need for a policy shift from episodic outbreak response toward sustained dengue preparedness in humanitarian settings, including strengthened surveillance systems, integrated diagnostic strategies, community-based early referral, and coordinated vector control interventions.

title: Dengue virus-2 triggers Epstein-Barr virus replication in primary B cells by co-opting the IRE1-XBP1 signaling axis.
abstract: ABSTRACT The intricate interplay between co-infecting viral pathogens within a host can significantly influence disease outcomes. Dengue virus (DENV), a globally prevalent arbovirus from the Flaviviridae family, and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), a ubiquitous human herpesvirus, share extensive geographical overlap, yet their potential interactions remain largely uncharacterized. This study elucidates a novel molecular mechanism whereby DENV-2 infection triggers disruption of EBV latency. We systematically demonstrate that DENV-2 infection consistently induces EBV lytic gene expression and viral replication in diverse cellular contexts, including epithelial cell lines and, critically, in primary human B lymphocytes—the principal reservoir of latent EBV. Mechanistically, we establish that the substantial burden of DENV-2 protein synthesis and replication induces profound endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress, activating the unfolded protein response (UPR). Through pharmacological inhibition and genetic knockdown, we dissect the three UPR branches and identify the IRE1-XBP1 signaling axis as the indispensable pathway for this phenomenon. DENV-2 infection promotes the endoribonuclease activity of IRE1, leading to the unconventional splicing of XBP1 mRNA into its transcriptionally active isoform, XBP1s. Depletion of IRE1 or XBP1 attenuated DENV-induced BZLF1 expression, whereas ectopic XBP1s expression increased BZLF1 transcription. Our findings delineate a precise virus-host-virus signaling model in which an acute RNA virus engages a cellular stress pathway to promote entry into the EBV lytic program and viral genome amplification. This provides a new paradigm for understanding the pathobiology of dengue fever and the complex dynamics of the human virome. IMPORTANCE This research uncovers a previously unrecognized molecular dialog between two of the world’s most common viral pathogens. By demonstrating that dengue virus infection can awaken dormant Epstein-Barr virus, this study provides a mechanistic basis for the long-suspected but poorly understood complications arising from viral co-infections. We pinpoint a specific cellular stress pathway, the IRE1-XBP1 axis of the unfolded protein response (UPR), as the critical molecular switch. This discovery is significant because it not only explains how an acute viral illness can trigger the reactivation of a latent, potentially oncogenic virus but also opens new avenues for therapeutic intervention. Understanding this intricate interplay could lead to novel strategies for managing severe dengue and other diseases where viral co-infection is a contributing factor to pathogenesis.

We systematically demonstrate that DENV-2 infection consistently induces EBV lytic gene expression and viral replication in diverse cellular contexts, including epithelial cell lines and, critically, in primary human B lymphocytes—the principal reservoir of latent EBV. Mechanistically, we establish that the substantial burden of DENV-2 protein synthesis and replication induces profound endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress, activating the unfolded protein response (UPR). Through pharmacological inhibition and genetic knockdown, we dissect the three UPR branches and identify the IRE1-XBP1 signaling axis as the indispensable pathway for this phenomenon. DENV-2 infection promotes the endoribonuclease activity of IRE1, leading to the unconventional splicing of XBP1 mRNA into its transcriptionally active isoform, XBP1s. Depletion of IRE1 or XBP1 attenuated DENV-induced BZLF1 expression, whereas ectopic XBP1s expression increased BZLF1 transcription. Our findings delineate a precise virus-host-virus signaling model in which an acute RNA virus engages a cellular stress pathway to promote entry into the EBV lytic program and viral genome amplification. This provides a new paradigm for understanding the pathobiology of dengue fever and the complex dynamics of the human virome. IMPORTANCE This research uncovers a previously unrecognized molecular dialog between two of the world’s most common viral pathogens. By demonstrating that dengue virus infection can awaken dormant Epstein-Barr virus, this study provides a mechanistic basis for the long-suspected but poorly understood complications arising from viral co-infections. We pinpoint a specific cellular stress pathway, the IRE1-XBP1 axis of the unfolded protein response (UPR), as the critical molecular switch. This discovery is significant because it not only explains how an acute viral illness can trigger the reactivation of a latent, potentially oncogenic virus but also opens new avenues for therapeutic intervention. Understanding this intricate interplay could lead to novel strategies for managing severe dengue and other diseases where viral co-infection is a contributing factor to pathogenesis.

analysis_zh.methods: 本研究采用药理学抑制和基因沉默技术来解析未折叠蛋白反应(UPR)的各个分支,并确定IRE1-XBP1信号轴作为相关通路。此外,还包括评估DENV-2对EBV裂解基因表达和复制影响的实验。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究结果显示,DENV-2感染在上皮细胞系和原代人类B淋巴细胞中均能持续诱导EBV裂解基因表达和病毒复制。IRE1或XBP1的耗竭会减弱DENV诱导的BZLF1表达,而XBP1s的过表达则会增加BZLF1的转录。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为DENV-2感染通过IRE1-XBP1信号轴触发EBV重新激活的新型分子机制的证据。这一发现为理解病毒共感染如何影响发病机制提供了新的视角。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现对理解登革热的病原生物学以及人类病毒组内的复杂相互作用具有重要意义,可能为管理重症登革热及其他与病毒共感染相关的疾病提供策略参考。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其主要基于体外实验,可能无法完全反映体内情况。然而,由于采用了系统性的药理学和遗传学方法来识别关键通路,其证据是强有力的。

title: Transmission Dynamics of Dengue Virus, Ceará State, Brazil, 2010-2025.
abstract: We evaluated the transmission dynamics of dengue virus (DENV) during 2010-2025 in Ceará State, Brazil. Ceará has been a dengue hyperendemic region, where all 4 DENV serotypes co-circulate, predominantly DENV-1 and DENV-2, and where DENV-3 was recently reintroduced. Our findings provide an epidemiologic baseline for postlicensure dengue vaccine evaluation.

analysis.summary_en: This paper investigates how dengue virus (DENV) spread across Ceará State, Brazil, over the 15‐year period from 2010 to 2025. Ceará is described as a hyperendemic area where all four DENV serotypes circulate, with DENV‐1 and DENV‐2 predominating and DENV‐3 recently re‐introduced. By characterising long‐term transmission patterns, the authors intend to create an epidemiologic baseline that can support post‐licensure evaluation of dengue vaccines. title_zh: 传播登革病毒在巴西塞阿拉州2010-2025年的动态变化
source_body_en: We evaluated the transmission dynamics of dengue virus (DENV) during 2010-2025 in Ceará State, Brazil. Ceará has been a dengue hyperendemic region, where all 4 DENV serotypes co-circulate, predominantly DENV-1 and DENV-2, and where DENV-3 was recently reintroduced. Our findings provide an epidemiologic baseline for postlicensure dengue vaccine evaluation.

title: Molecular epidemiology of dengue virus in the Bangka Belitung Islands, Indonesia, during the COVID-19 pandemic.
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) infection poses a major global health challenge with a rising number of infections worldwide. In Indonesia, molecular epidemiological studies have been limited, focusing primarily on Java Island, which has led to a sufficiency in comprehensive data of DENV characteristics. During the COVID-19 pandemic, fewer DENV epidemiological studies were conducted, further leaving a gap in our understanding of viral circulation during this period. Characterization of DENV serotypes, genotypes, and nucleotide substitutions is essential for improving clinical management and informing vaccine strategies. This study employed a cross-sectional design with consecutive sampling of suspected dengue patients from a private clinic and hospital in Bangka-Belitung, Indonesia, between 2019 and 2023. Patients with fever and two or more clinical symptoms of DENV infection were included. DENV infection was confirmed by NS1 antigen test, and positive samples were further analyzed for DENV serotypes by RT-PCR, followed by envelope gene analysis for phylogenetic characterization. Out of 92 suspected dengue infections, 74 cases (80.43%) were confirmed for DENV infection via RT-PCR, NS-1, or IgM antibody tests, with the majority of confirmed dengue cases occurred in children. DENV-3 was found to be the most dominant serotype (38.71%), followed by DENV-1 (11.83%), which aligns with previous studies characterizing the serotypes of circulating DENV strains. Phylogenetic analysis of DENV (1-4) during the COVID-19 pandemic revealed that these strains clustered into a distinct groups under the same genotypes as earlier outbreaks. This molecular epidemiology and seroprevalence data provide valuable insight into the circulating DENV strains in Indonesia. AUTHOR SUMMARY: Dengue virus (DENV) remains a major public health problem in Indonesia, one of the countries with the highest dengue burden worldwide. Although DENV is endemic throughout the Indonesian archipelago, information on the genetic diversity and circulation of DENV is still limited in many regions outside Java Island. Bangka Belitung Province is an understudied area where molecular epidemiological data are largely unavailable, making it difficult to understand local transmission patterns and support evidence-based control strategies. In this study, we investigated DENV infections in Bangka Belitung before and during the COVID-19 pandemic. We analyzed clinical samples from patients with suspected DENV infection to determine circulating serotypes and genetic characteristics of the virus. All four DENV serotypes were detected, with DENV-3 identified as the predominant serotype throughout the study period. Phylogenetic analyses showed that the circulating viruses belonged to genotypes that have been reported previously in Indonesia, indicating ongoing endemic transmission and genetic diversity within the country. Our findings provide the first comprehensive molecular epidemiological data on DENV circulation in Bangka Belitung. These results contribute to a better understanding of dengue transmission dynamics in Indonesia and highlight the importance of continuous molecular surveillance to detect viral introductions, monitor genetic changes, and support DENV prevention and control programs.
journal: Infection, genetics and evolution : journal of molecular epidemiology and evolutionary genetics in infectious diseases

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒(DENV)感染仍然是全球主要的公共卫生挑战,其全球感染人数持续上升。本研究旨在填补印度尼西亚关于DENV分子流行病学数据的空白,特别是在邦加-勿里洞群岛。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用横断面研究设计,于2019年至2023年间在印度尼西亚邦加-勿里洞群岛的私人诊所和医院中连续采集疑似登革热患者的样本。纳入标准为具有发热症状以及至少两个登革热临床症状的患者。
elements_zh.methods: 通过NS1抗原检测确认DENV感染,阳性样本进一步通过RT-PCR分析确定DENV血清型,并通过包膜基因分析进行系统发育特征分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在92例疑似登革热感染病例中,有74例(80.43%)通过RT-PCR、NS-1或IgM抗体检测确认为DENV感染,其中大多数确诊病例发生在儿童中。所有四种DENV血清型均被检测到,其中DENV-3在整个研究期间被确认为主要血清型。系统发育分析显示,传播的病毒株属于此前在印度尼西亚报道过的基因型。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,DENV在印度尼西亚持续地方性流行并具有遗传多样性,其中DENV-3是最常见的血清型。本研究为邦加-勿里洞地区的DENV传播提供了首个全面的分子流行病学数据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于更好地理解印度尼西亚登革热的传播动态,并强调了持续进行分子监测的重要性,以检测病毒引入、监测遗传变化并支持DENV的预防和控制计划。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其横断面研究设计,以及某些人群可能被低估的代表性。由于研究基于单一地点和时间段,其证据强度中等。

DENV-3 was found to be the most dominant serotype (38.71%), followed by DENV-1 (11.83%), which aligns with previous studies characterizing the serotypes of circulating DENV strains. Phylogenetic analysis of DENV (1-4) during the COVID-19 pandemic revealed that these strains clustered into a distinct groups under the same genotypes as earlier outbreaks. This molecular epidemiology and seroprevalence data provide valuable insight into the circulating DENV strains in Indonesia. AUTHOR SUMMARY: Dengue virus (DENV) remains a major public health problem in Indonesia, one of the countries with the highest dengue burden worldwide. Although DENV is endemic throughout the Indonesian archipelago, information on the genetic diversity and circulation of DENV is still limited in many regions outside Java Island. Bangka Belitung Province is an understudied area where molecular epidemiological data are largely unavailable, making it difficult to understand local transmission patterns and support evidence-based control strategies. In this study, we investigated DENV infections in Bangka Belitung before and during the COVID-19 pandemic. We analyzed clinical samples from patients with suspected DENV infection to determine circulating serotypes and genetic characteristics of the virus. All four DENV serotypes were detected, with DENV-3 identified as the predominant serotype throughout the study period. Phylogenetic analyses showed that the circulating viruses belonged to genotypes that have been reported previously in Indonesia, indicating ongoing endemic transmission and genetic diversity within the country. Our findings provide the first comprehensive molecular epidemiological data on DENV circulation in Bangka Belitung. These results contribute to a better understanding of dengue transmission dynamics in Indonesia and highlight the importance of continuous molecular surveillance to detect viral introductions, monitor genetic changes, and support DENV prevention and control programs.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒(DENV)感染仍然是全球主要的公共卫生挑战,其全球感染人数持续上升。本研究旨在填补印度尼西亚关于DENV分子流行病学数据的空白,特别是在邦加-勿里洞群岛。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用横断面研究设计,于2019年至2023年间在印度尼西亚邦加-勿里洞群岛的私人诊所和医院中连续采集疑似登革热患者的样本。纳入标准为具有发热症状以及至少两个登革热临床症状的患者。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过NS1抗原检测确认DENV感染,阳性样本进一步通过RT-PCR分析确定DENV血清型,并通过包膜基因分析进行系统发育特征分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在92例疑似登革热感染病例中,有74例(80.43%)通过RT-PCR、NS-1或IgM抗体检测确认为DENV感染,其中大多数确诊病例发生在儿童中。所有四种DENV血清型均被检测到,其中DENV-3在整个研究期间被确认为主要血清型。系统发育分析显示,传播的病毒株属于此前在印度尼西亚报道过的基因型。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,DENV在印度尼西亚持续地方性流行并具有遗传多样性,其中DENV-3是最常见的血清型。本研究为邦加-勿里洞地区的DENV传播提供了首个全面的分子流行病学数据。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于更好地理解印度尼西亚登革热的传播动态,并强调了持续进行分子监测的重要性,以检测病毒引入、监测遗传变化并支持DENV的预防和控制计划。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其横断面研究设计,以及某些人群可能被低估的代表性。由于研究基于单一地点和时间段,其证据强度中等。

title: circEPSTI1 regulates miR-942-5p-SERPINE1-AKT1 signaling axis to enhance dengue infection and is suppressed by Tiplaxtinin.
abstract: Circular RNAs (circRNAs) have recently been identified as crucial regulators of gene expression in various diseases. Their role in dengue remains unexplored. In this study, circEPSTI1 induction was observed in peripheral blood mononuclear cells and plasma of dengue patients. The induction of circEPSTI1 is interferon-dependent and enhances DENV infection by sponging the expression of miR-942-5p. The antiviral role of miR-942-5p is mediated by bidirectional inhibition through targeting conserved genomic sequences of the DENV genome of different subtypes across NS1, NS3, and NS5 and the host AKT1 signaling pathway. RNA-seq analysis of DENV-infected circEPSTI1 knockdown A549 cells identified SERPINE1 and AKT1 signaling pathways to be dysregulated significantly. circEPSTI1 relieves the inhibition of miR-942-5p over DENV genomic RNA and the host SERPINE1 to activate AKT1 signaling. The activation of AKT1 signaling facilitates cell survival and enhances DENV replication. The expression of SERPINE1 and circEPSTI1 was upregulated in Dengue patients, and pharmaceutical inhibition of SERPINE1 through Tiplaxtinin inhibits the DENV replication by reducing the expression of circEPSTI1. Overall, our result demonstrates the therapeutic potential of Tiplaxtinin by targeting the circEPSTI1-miR-942-5p-SERPINE1-AKT1 axis in dengue treatment.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

abstract_zh: 环状RNA(circRNAs)最近被鉴定为多种疾病中基因表达的关键调控因子。其在登革病毒中的作用尚未被探索。本研究中,在登革热患者的外周血单核细胞和血浆中观察到circEPSTI1的诱导。circEPSTI1的诱导依赖于干扰素,并通过海绵吸附miR-942-5p的表达来增强DENV感染。miR-942-5p的作用是通过靶向不同亚型DENV在NS1、NS3和NS5中的保守基因组序列以及AKT1信号通路实现双向抑制。对DENV感染的circEPSTI1敲低A549细胞进行RNA-seq分析,发现SERPINE1和AKT1信号通路显著失调。circEPSTI1通过缓解miR-942-5p对DENV基因组RNA和SERPINE1的抑制,激活AKT1信号通路。AKT1信号通路的激活促进了细胞存活并增强了DENV复制。在登革热患者中,SERPINE1和circEPSTI1的表达均上调,而通过Tiplaxtinin抑制SERPINE1可减少circEPSTI1的表达,从而抑制DENV复制。总体而言,我们的结果表明,通过靶向circEPSTI1-miR-942-5p-SERPINE1-AKT1轴,Tiplaxtinin具有治疗登革热的潜力。

title: Solanaceae-Derived Spirostane Saponins Inhibit Dengue Virus Replication and Viral Protein Expression and Exhibit Activity Against Multiple Arboviruses.
abstract: Mosquito-borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), represent a growing global health burden, yet no specific antiviral therapies are currently available for most of these infections. This unmet need highlights the importance of identifying novel antiviral compounds from biologically relevant sources such as plant-derived natural products. In this study, a bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to identify novel antiviral compounds from plant-derived natural products to address the unmet need for specific antiviral therapies against mosquito-borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV).
analysis.study_design_and_population: A bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells.
analysis.methods: Functional assays were used to evaluate the antiviral activity of extracts, which led to the isolation and structural characterization of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins.
analysis.main_results: Five extracts significantly reduced DENV-2 infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. The isolated compounds inhibited DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents, with cross-arboviral efficacy against ZIKV and CHIKV.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings could inform the development of new antiviral therapies for dengue and other arboviruses, potentially reducing the global health burden of these infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of a non-randomized, in vitro approach, which may limit generalizability. The evidence strength is moderate due to the preliminary nature of the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study identified spirostane saponins from Solanaceae plants as promising antiviral compounds against DENV-2, with cross-arboviral efficacy against ZIKV and CHIKV, addressing the unmet need for specific antiviral therapies against mosquito-borne arboviruses.

title_zh: 茄科来源的螺甾烷皂苷抑制登革病毒复制和病毒蛋白表达,并对多种虫媒病毒表现活性。
source_body_en: Mosquito-borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), represent a growing global health burden, yet no specific antiviral therapies are currently available for most of these infections. This unmet need highlights the importance of identifying novel antiviral compounds from biologically relevant sources such as plant-derived natural products. In this study, a bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.
abstract_zh: 蚊媒虫媒病毒(包括登革病毒(DENV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV))构成了日益增长的全球健康负担,但目前针对这些感染的特异性抗病毒药物疗法尚不普及。这种未满足的医疗需求凸显了从生物相关来源(如植物来源的天然产物)中识别新型抗病毒药物化合物的重要性。本研究采用基于生物活性的筛选方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行分析,以鉴定具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物,针对Vero细胞中DENV-2的感染。五种提取物显著降低了病毒的感染性,其中Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.在非细胞毒性浓度下实现了完全抑制。随后的分级和纯化过程分离出四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷,其结构通过超高效液相色谱-二极管阵列检测-质谱(UPLC-DAD-MS)和一维/二维核磁共振(1D/2D NMR)光谱进行表征。功能实验表明,这些化合物抑制DENV复制,表现为病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度的显著下降。阶段特异性分析显示,其抗病毒药物活性主要与病毒生命周期的细胞内阶段相关,这与抑制病毒复制和/或蛋白质加工一致。分子对接分析支持这些发现,预测这些化合物与关键病毒酶(特别是NS5 RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶和NS3解旋酶/蛋白酶)具有有利的相互作用。重要的是,分离出的化合物对ZIKV和CHIKV也表现出抗病毒药物活性,表明其具有跨虫媒病毒的疗效。综上所述,这些发现表明螺甾烷皂苷是具有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物。

title: Economic Evaluation of an E-Dengue Early Warning System for Proactive Dengue Prevention in the Mekong Delta Region, Vietnam: A Protocol
abstract: BACKGROUND: Numerous dengue early warning tools have been developed, while few have been successfully integrated into routine surveillance systems. The E-Dengue tool, designed using the "Useful, Usable, and Used" framework, aims to predict dengue epidemics three months in advance in the Mekong Delta Region (MDR) of Vietnam. This protocol outlines the economic evaluation of an early warning system in which E-Dengue alerts prompt proactive dengue prevention and control interventions. METHODS: An economic evaluation using a societal perspective will be conducted alongside a cluster-randomized controlled trial. Costs and outcomes will be compared between the E-Dengue early warning system and routine practice. The primary outcome measure will be disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) and the secondary outcome measure will be dengue cases. The mean cost of a dengue case will be quantified by conducting a cost of illness substudy that will utilize both hospital billing records and structured surveys of patients and informal caregivers and by evidence synthesis from the literature. The cost-effectiveness of E-Dengue will be assessed over a 2-year time horizon and expressed as the incremental cost per DALY averted and per dengue case averted, respectively, and compared against a prespecified cost-effectiveness threshold. The robustness of the results will be evaluated using one-way and probabilistic sensitivity analyses. DISCUSSION: Demonstrating that E-Dengue is cost-effective will provide rigorous evidence to support its integration into routine surveillance in the MDR and potentially for it to be scaled up and adapted to other areas of Vietnam and nations with similar conditions. Conversely, if E-Dengue is not cost-effective, the study will provide critical lessons for the design and implementation of future early warning tools. TRIAL REGISTRATION NO: ACTRN12626000402347.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the economic feasibility of integrating an early warning system, E-Dengue, into routine surveillance to predict dengue epidemics in the Mekong Delta Region, Vietnam. Few dengue early warning tools have been successfully integrated into routine surveillance systems, highlighting the need for rigorous evaluation.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study will conduct an economic evaluation using a societal perspective alongside a cluster-randomized controlled trial, comparing the E-Dengue early warning system to routine practice in the Mekong Delta Region, Vietnam.
analysis.methods: The economic evaluation will compare costs and outcomes between the E-Dengue early warning system and routine practice. Costs will be quantified through a cost of illness substudy using hospital billing records and structured surveys, and outcomes will be measured in terms of disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) and dengue cases. The cost-effectiveness will be assessed using a 2-year time horizon and compared against a prespecified cost-effectiveness threshold. Sensitivity analyses will be conducted to evaluate the robustness of the results.
analysis.main_results: The study will directly observe the economic impact of the E-Dengue early warning system compared to routine practice, including costs and outcomes such as DALYs and dengue cases.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Demonstrating that E-Dengue is cost-effective will provide rigorous evidence to support its integration into routine surveillance in the Mekong Delta Region and potentially for scaling up and adaptation to other areas. Conversely, if E-Dengue is not cost-effective, the study will provide critical lessons for the design and implementation of future early warning tools.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings will inform the integration of E-Dengue into routine surveillance, potentially reducing the burden of dengue cases and improving public health outcomes in the Mekong Delta Region and similar areas.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of a cluster-randomized controlled trial, which may introduce bias, and the reliance on cost and outcome measures that may not fully capture the economic impact. The evidence strength is moderate due to the use of a societal perspective and the assessment of cost-effectiveness over a 2-year time horizon.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the economic feasibility of integrating the E-Dengue early warning system into routine surveillance in the Mekong Delta Region, Vietnam, by comparing costs and outcomes with routine practice. The findings will inform the integration of E-Dengue and potentially its adaptation to other areas.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估将E-Dengue早期预警系统整合到越南湄公河三角洲地区的常规监测系统中以预测登革热疫情的经济可行性。仅有少数登革热早期预警工具成功整合到常规监测系统中,这凸显了进行严谨评估的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究将采用社会视角进行经济评估,并与集群随机对照试验同时进行,比较E-Dengue早期预警系统与越南湄公河三角洲地区的常规做法。
elements_zh.methods: 经济评估将比较E-Dengue早期预警系统与常规做法的成本和结果。成本将通过一项疾病成本子研究进行量化,该研究将利用医院账单记录和结构化调查,结果将通过伤残调整生命年(DALYs)和登革热病例数进行衡量。成本效益将通过2年的时间范围进行评估,并与预设的成本效益阈值进行比较。将进行敏感性分析以评估结果的稳健性。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究将直接观察E-Dengue早期预警系统与常规做法相比的经济影响,包括成本和结果,如伤残调整生命年(DALYs)和登革热病例数。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 证明E-Dengue具有成本效益将为将其整合到越南湄公河三角洲地区的常规监测系统中提供严谨的证据,并可能为在其他地区推广和适应该系统提供支持。相反,如果E-Dengue不具成本效益,本研究将为未来早期预警工具的设计和实施提供关键的教训。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果将为将E-Dengue整合到常规监测系统提供信息,可能减少登革热病例负担并改善湄公河三角洲地区及其他类似地区的公共卫生结果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用集群随机对照试验,这可能引入偏倚,以及依赖可能无法完全反映经济影响的成本和结果指标。由于采用社会视角并评估2年时间范围内的成本效益,证据强度为中等。

abstract_zh: 背景:尽管已开发出多种登革热早期预警工具,但仅有少数成功整合到常规监测系统中。E-Dengue工具采用"有用、可用、被使用"框架设计,旨在提前三个月预测越南湄公河三角洲地区(MDR)的登革热疫情。本方案概述了对早期预警系统进行经济评估的过程,该系统通过E-Dengue警报触发主动的登革热预防和控制干预措施。方法:将采用社会视角进行经济评估,并与集群随机对照试验同时进行。将比较E-Dengue早期预警系统与常规做法的成本和结果。主要结果指标为伤残调整生命年(DALYs),次要结果指标为登革热病例数。通过开展一项疾病成本子研究,量化每例登革热病例的平均成本,该研究将结合医院账单记录、患者和非正式护理者的结构化调查以及文献中的证据综合分析。E-Dengue的成本效益将在2年的时间范围内进行评估,并以每避免一个DALY和每避免一例登革热病例的增量成本分别表达,并与预设的成本效益阈值进行比较。结果的稳健性将通过单变量和概率敏感性分析进行评估。讨论:证明E-Dengue具有成本效益将为将其整合到越南湄公河三角洲地区的常规监测系统中提供严谨的证据,并可能为在越南其他地区以及具有类似条件的国家推广和适应该系统提供支持。相反,如果E-Dengue不具成本效益,该研究将为未来早期预警工具的设计和实施提供关键的教训。试验注册号:ACTRN12626000402347。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估将E-Dengue早期预警系统整合到越南湄公河三角洲地区的常规监测系统中以预测登革热疫情的经济可行性。仅有少数登革热早期预警工具成功整合到常规监测系统中,这凸显了进行严谨评估的必要性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究将采用社会视角进行经济评估,并与集群随机对照试验同时进行,比较E-Dengue早期预警系统与越南湄公河三角洲地区的常规做法。
analysis_zh.methods: 经济评估将比较E-Dengue早期预警系统与常规做法的成本和结果。成本将通过一项疾病成本子研究进行量化,该研究将利用医院账单记录和结构化调查,结果将通过伤残调整生命年(DALYs)和登革热病例数进行衡量。成本效益将通过2年的时间范围进行评估,并与预设的成本效益阈值进行比较。将进行敏感性分析以评估结果的稳健性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 本研究将直接观察E-Dengue早期预警系统与常规做法相比的经济影响,包括成本和结果,如伤残调整生命年(DALYs)和登革热病例数。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 证明E-Dengue具有成本效益将为将其整合到越南湄公河三角洲地区的常规监测系统中提供严谨的证据,并可能为在其他地区推广和适应该系统提供支持。相反,如果E-Dengue不具成本效益,本研究将为未来早期预警工具的设计和实施提供关键的教训。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果将为将E-Dengue整合到常规监测系统提供信息,可能减少登革热病例负担并改善湄公河三角洲地区及其他类似地区的公共卫生结果。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用集群随机对照试验,这可能引入偏倚,以及依赖可能无法完全反映经济影响的成本和结果指标。由于采用社会视角并评估2年时间范围内的成本效益,证据强度为中等。

title: Computational Insights Into the Conformational Dynamics of the Dengue Virus Capsid Protein.
abstract: The Dengue virus (DENV) capsid protein plays an important role in the viral lifecycle, including encapsidation of the genome, recruitment of lipid droplets, and assembly of particles. Capsid protein includes a hydrophobic pocket, which plays a central role in these functions and switches between closed and open conformations. This work studies the conformational change pathway of the capsid protein, specifically how the molecular mechanisms controlling the opening and closing of the hydrophobic pocket are controlled. By using a combination of different types of molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods, we share insights on the structural rearrangements that play a crucial role in governing these transitions. Our results show that lipid binding modulates the accessibility of the hydrophobic pocket through environmental cues. In the open conformation, the pocket is involved in the interaction with lipids, stabilization of capsid dimers, and the promotion of immature virus assembly. Conversely, the closed conformation protects the hydrophobic pocket from the surrounding aqueous media as also preventing premature interactions in the solution phase that might disrupt protein stability. Such insights allow a deep understanding of capsid protein's conformational dynamics and represent a promising set of potent targets for antiviral strategies aiming to interfere with its functional transitions.

Capsid protein includes a hydrophobic pocket, which plays a central role in these functions and switches between closed and open conformations. This work studies the conformational change pathway of the capsid protein, specifically how the molecular mechanisms controlling the opening and closing of the hydrophobic pocket are controlled. By using a combination of different types of molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods, we share insights on the structural rearrangements that play a crucial role in governing these transitions. Our results show that lipid binding modulates the accessibility of the hydrophobic pocket through environmental cues. In the open conformation, the pocket is involved in the interaction with lipids, stabilization of capsid dimers, and the promotion of immature virus assembly. Conversely, the closed conformation protects the hydrophobic pocket from the surrounding aqueous media as also preventing premature interactions in the solution phase that might disrupt protein stability. Such insights allow a deep understanding of capsid protein's conformational dynamics and represent a promising set of potent targets for antiviral strategies aiming to interfere with its functional transitions.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the conformational dynamics of the Dengue virus capsid protein, focusing on the hydrophobic pocket's role in viral lifecycle functions and transitions between open and closed conformations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research employed molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods to study the conformational change pathway of the capsid protein.
analysis.methods: Molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods were used to investigate the structural rearrangements governing the transitions of the capsid protein's hydrophobic pocket.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that lipid binding modulates the accessibility of the hydrophobic pocket, and the open conformation facilitates interactions with lipids and virus assembly, while the closed conformation protects the pocket from aqueous media and premature interactions.

analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the reliance on computational methods, which may not fully capture all aspects of the capsid protein's behavior in vivo.

analysis.summary_en: This study used molecular dynamics simulations to investigate the conformational dynamics of the Dengue virus capsid protein, revealing that lipid binding modulates the hydrophobic pocket's accessibility and that the open conformation facilitates virus assembly, while the closed conformation protects the pocket from aqueous media. These insights could inform antiviral strategies targeting the capsid protein's functional transitions.

title_zh: 对 登革病毒 衣壳蛋白构象动力学的计算见解。
source_body_en: The Dengue virus (DENV) capsid protein plays an important role in the viral lifecycle, including encapsidation of the genome, recruitment of lipid droplets, and assembly of particles. Capsid protein includes a hydrophobic pocket, which plays a central role in these functions and switches between closed and open conformations. This work studies the conformational change pathway of the capsid protein, specifically how the molecular mechanisms controlling the opening and closing of the hydrophobic pocket are controlled. By using a combination of different types of molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods, we share insights on the structural rearrangements that play a crucial role in governing these transitions. Our results show that lipid binding modulates the accessibility of the hydrophobic pocket through environmental cues. In the open conformation, the pocket is involved in the interaction with lipids, stabilization of capsid dimers, and the promotion of immature virus assembly. Conversely, the closed conformation protects the hydrophobic pocket from the surrounding aqueous media as also preventing premature interactions in the solution phase that might disrupt protein stability. Such insights allow a deep understanding of capsid protein's conformational dynamics and represent a promising set of potent targets for antiviral strategies aiming to interfere with its functional transitions.
abstract_zh: 登革病毒 (DENV) 衣壳蛋白在病毒生命周期中发挥重要作用,包括 基因组 的衣壳化、脂滴的招募和颗粒的组装。衣壳蛋白包含一个疏水口袋,它在这些功能以及闭合和开放构象之间的转换中发挥着核心作用。这项工作研究了衣壳蛋白的构象变化途径,特别是如何控制控制疏水袋打开和关闭的分子机制。通过结合使用不同类型的分子动力学模拟和增强的采样方法,我们分享了对在控制这些转变中发挥关键作用的结构重排的见解。我们的结果表明,脂质结合通过环境因素调节疏水袋的可及性。在开放构象中,口袋参与与脂质的相互作用、衣壳二聚体的稳定以及促进未成熟病毒的组装。相反,闭合构象可以保护疏水袋免受周围水介质的影响,同时还可以防止溶液相中过早的相互作用,从而破坏蛋白质的稳定性。这些见解使人们能够深入了解衣壳蛋白的构象动力学,并为旨在干扰其功能转变的 抗病毒药物 策略提供了一组有前景的有效靶标。

title: Cardiac Involvement in Patients with Dengue Fever: A Clinical Analysis.
abstract: Abstract Background: The highest incidence of dengue fever (DF) is seen in Southeast Asia, India, and the American tropics. Arboviruses represent a serious public health problem in tropical and subtropical regions of the world. Although dengue shock syndrome (DSS) has been attributed largely to decreased intravascular volume due to capillary leakage of plasma into the interstitial space, a few recent studies have reported that it may be due to cardiac involvement. Hence, the present study was planned to assess the cardiac manifestations of DF and to identify subclinical/latent cardiac involvement. Aims and Objectives: To study was to evaluate the various cardiac manifestations of DF along with its prevalence. Materials and Methods: This descriptive cross-sectional study evaluated the prevalence and severity correlation of cardiac manifestations in dengue fever patients at a rural tertiary care center between January and December 2025. A total of 110 patients aged 13 years and older with confirmed dengue serology were enrolled after providing written informed consent. The study excluded individuals with pre-existing heart conditions, electrolyte imbalances, mixed infections, or medications affecting heart rate and rhythm. Data collection involved detailed clinical histories, daily vital sign monitoring, complete blood counts, cardiac enzyme assays, electrocardiograms, and 2D echocardiograms conducted after fever resolution. Cardiac involvement was identified through rhythm disturbances, enzyme elevations, and structural or electrical abnormalities, with patients classified according to WHO criteria following ethical approval. Results: In this study, out of the eight patients with DSS, six patients (75%) had positive troponin I. Eight patients were found to have DSS with 87.5% of them having raised CKMB levels compared to 42.3% and 39.5% in dengue hemorrhagic fever and DF, respectively. Conclusion: Cardiac involvement in dengue can contribute to hemodynamic instability in dengue patients. ECG can prove a useful tool, especially in patients with hemodynamic instability to plan for more efficient management.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated cardiac involvement in dengue fever patients, focusing on its potential role in dengue shock syndrome. Conducted at a rural tertiary care center between January and December 2025, the research evaluated 110 patients with confirmed dengue serology. Cardiac manifestations were assessed through clinical histories, vital signs, blood tests, and imaging. Results showed that 75% of patients with dengue shock syndrome had elevated troponin I levels, and 87.5% had increased CKMB levels compared to lower rates in dengue hemorrhagic fever and DF. The authors suggest that cardiac involvement may contribute to hemodynamic instability, highlighting the importance of ECG in managing severe dengue cases. The study's findings are moderate in strength due to its cross-sectional design and limited geographic scope.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估登革热的心脏表现,并识别亚临床/潜伏性心脏受累,因为最近的报告表明心脏受累可能在登革休克综合征中起作用。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项描述性横断面研究评估了2025年1月至12月期间在农村三级医疗中心接受治疗的DF患者中,心脏表现的患病率及其严重程度的相关性。总共纳入了110名年龄在13岁及以上、经确认感染登革病毒的患者,在提供书面知情同意后进行研究。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在本研究中,8名DSS患者中有6名(75%)表现出阳性肌钙蛋白I。8名患者被诊断为DSS,其中87.5%的患者CKMB水平升高,相比之下登革出血热为42.3%,DF为39.5%。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,登革热中的心脏受累可能在登革热患者中导致血流动力学不稳定,强调了登革休克综合征发病机制的新视角。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为登革热患者的更针对性的监测和管理策略提供信息,特别是那些存在血流动力学不稳定情况的患者,通过强调心脏受累在疾病严重程度中的作用。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其横断面设计和单一中心设置,这可能影响其结果的普遍性。证据强度中等,因为它提供了关于登革热患者心脏受累的具体发现,但缺乏更广泛的验证。

title: A Live Attenuated Dengue Virus Vaccine (Dengvaxia) is Suppressed in Individuals with Immunity to Serotype 4
abstract: Abstract Background Dengvaxia® was the first live attenuated tetravalent dengue virus (DENV) vaccine to be tested and approved for use in people. While Dengvaxia was designed to be tetravalent, in humans, the vaccine performed like a monovalent DENV4 vaccine because the DENV4 vaccine virus replicated better than other vaccine serotypes. Dengvaxia® was safe and efficacious in children who were DENV-immune at baseline and contraindicated for use in DENV-naïve children. Methods When Dengvaxia® was rolled out as a pediatric vaccine in the Philippines in 2016, we established a prospective cohort to assess vaccine performance by baseline dengue serostatus. Here we report on how baseline monotypic immunity to each serotype (reflecting one past DENV infection) impacted Dengvaxia® responses. Results We observed that in children with baseline immunity to DENV1, 2 or 3, the vaccine stimulated a secondary serotype cross-neutralizing Ab response, which likely explains the overall favorable performance of the vaccine in seropositive children enrolled in phase 3 trials. We observed a high frequency (61%) of vaccine suppression among DENV4 monotypic immune children. Conclusions Our results confirm the replication dominance of the DENV4 vaccine component in Dengvaxia® and directly implicate pre-existing DENV4 immunity in the suppression of the vaccine. Our results have broader implications for evaluating the performance of other DENV vaccines in seropositive individuals.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate how baseline immunity to specific dengue serotypes affects the performance of the Dengvaxia® vaccine, addressing the knowledge gap about vaccine efficacy in seropositive individuals.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was a prospective cohort established in the Philippines in 2016 to assess Dengvaxia® performance based on baseline dengue serostatus, focusing on children with immunity to DENV1, DENV2, DENV3, or DENV4.

title_zh: 一种活疫苗登革病毒(Dengvaxia)在对第4型登革病毒具有免疫力的个体中被抑制
source_body_en: Abstract Background Dengvaxia® was the first live attenuated tetravalent dengue virus (DENV) vaccine to be tested and approved for use in people. While Dengvaxia was designed to be tetravalent, in humans, the vaccine performed like a monovalent DENV4 vaccine because the DENV4 vaccine virus replicated better than other vaccine serotypes. Dengvaxia® was safe and efficacious in children who were DENV-immune at baseline and contraindicated for use in DENV-naïve children. Methods When Dengvaxia® was rolled out as a pediatric vaccine in the Philippines in 2016, we established a prospective cohort to assess vaccine performance by baseline dengue serostatus. Here we report on how baseline monotypic immunity to each serotype (reflecting one past DENV infection) impacted Dengvaxia® responses. Results We observed that in children with baseline immunity to DENV1, 2 or 3, the vaccine stimulated a secondary serotype cross-neutralizing Ab response, which likely explains the overall favorable performance of the vaccine in seropositive children enrolled in phase 3 trials. We observed a high frequency (61%) of vaccine suppression among DENV4 monotypic immune children. Conclusions Our results confirm the replication dominance of the DENV4 vaccine component in Dengvaxia® and directly implicate pre-existing DENV4 immunity in the suppression of the vaccine. Our results have broader implications for evaluating the performance of other DENV vaccines in seropositive individuals.

title: When the forest speaks again: in-depth genomic analysis of serotyping failure reveals geographic extension of sylvatic DENV-2 in southeastern Senegal, 2026
abstract: Abstract In August 2026, eight febrile patients in the Kédougou and Tambacounda regions of Senegal tested positive by pan-flavivirus and pan-dengue RT-PCR but could not be assigned to a serotype. In-depth genome sequencing identified sylvatic dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV-2, genotype VI). These findings indicate the re-emergence and geographic spread of DENV-2/GVI beyond its historical focus.

title: Feasibility and Acceptability of a Dengue Board Game for Primary Health Care Nurses
abstract: Background: Primary health care (PHC) nurses are central to dengue prevention and management, but lecture-based training might not effectively engage learners. Game-based learning offers an interactive alternative that promotes participation and skill reinforcement. Purpose: To evaluate the feasibility and acceptability of a dengue educational board game for PHC nurses. Methods: A single-arm pre-post feasibility study was conducted in two PHC units in Indonesia. The board game, developed from national dengue guidelines and validated by experts, integrated knowledge-based, case-based, and skill demonstration tasks. Feasibility was assessed through recruitment, attendance, and completion rates. Acceptability was measured with a five-item Likert scale and qualitative feedback. Exploratory outcomes of knowledge, attitudes, and confidence were descriptively summarized. Results: Feasibility criteria were met, with full participation and completion. Acceptability ratings were high, as all participants strongly agreed the game was enjoyable, relevant, and useful for knowledge and skills. Descriptive analyses suggested positive trends in post-intervention median scores for knowledge (from 4.0 to 6.0), attitudes (from 27.0 to 29.5), and confidence (from 18.5 to 21.5). Satisfaction was also high (median 25.0, interquartile range 24.3–25.0). Conclusions: The dengue board game was feasible and acceptable, supporting further evaluation in a controlled trial for scalable workforce training.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the feasibility and acceptability of a dengue educational board game for primary health care nurses in Indonesia. The game was developed from national guidelines and validated by experts, incorporating knowledge-based, case-based, and skill demonstration tasks. The study found that the game was fully participated in and highly acceptable, with positive trends in knowledge, attitudes, and confidence scores. The results suggest that the game could be a useful tool for training PHC nurses in dengue prevention and management. However, the study's single-arm design limits the strength of the evidence, and further controlled trials are needed to assess its effectiveness for scalable workforce training.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 初级卫生保健(PHC)护士在登革热预防和管理中起着核心作用,但以讲座为主的培训可能无法有效吸引学习者。基于游戏的学习提供了一种互动替代方案,能够促进参与和技能强化。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在印度尼西亚的两个初级卫生保健单位进行了一项单臂前后可行性研究。该研究聚焦于初级卫生保健护士,并评估了登革热教育棋盘游戏的可行性与可接受性。
elements_zh.methods: 该游戏基于国家登革热指南并由专家验证,整合了基于知识、基于病例和技能演示任务。通过招募、出勤率和完成率评估可行性。通过五点李克特量表和定性反馈测量可接受性。
elements_zh.main_results: 可行性标准已达成,所有参与者均完全参与并完成游戏。可接受性评分很高,所有参与者都强烈同意该游戏令人愉快、相关且有助于知识和技能的提升。描述性分析显示,干预后知识(从4.0到6.0)、态度(从27.0到29.5)和信心(从18.5到21.5)的中位数得分呈现积极趋势。满意度也很高(中位数25.0,四分位距24.3–25.0)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 登革热棋盘游戏具有可行性和可接受性,支持在受控试验中进一步评估,以实现可扩展的卫生人员培训。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,基于游戏的学习可能是培训初级卫生保健护士进行登革热预防和管理的有价值的工具,可能有助于提高参与度和知识保留率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是一项单臂可行性研究,这限制了因果结论的得出。证据强度中等,因为其基于描述性总结和自我报告测量。

title_zh: 登革热棋盘游戏在初级卫生保健护士中的可行性与可接受性
source_body_en: Background: Primary health care (PHC) nurses are central to dengue prevention and management, but lecture-based training might not effectively engage learners. Game-based learning offers an interactive alternative that promotes participation and skill reinforcement. Purpose: To evaluate the feasibility and acceptability of a dengue educational board game for PHC nurses. Methods: A single-arm pre-post feasibility study was conducted in two PHC units in Indonesia. The board game, developed from national dengue guidelines and validated by experts, integrated knowledge-based, case-based, and skill demonstration tasks. Feasibility was assessed through recruitment, attendance, and completion rates. Acceptability was measured with a five-item Likert scale and qualitative feedback. Exploratory outcomes of knowledge, attitudes, and confidence were descriptively summarized. Results: Feasibility criteria were met, with full participation and completion. Acceptability ratings were high, as all participants strongly agreed the game was enjoyable, relevant, and useful for knowledge and skills. Descriptive analyses suggested positive trends in post-intervention median scores for knowledge (from 4.0 to 6.0), attitudes (from 27.0 to 29.5), and confidence (from 18.5 to 21.5). Satisfaction was also high (median 25.0, interquartile range 24.3–25.0). Conclusions: The dengue board game was feasible and acceptable, supporting further evaluation in a controlled trial for scalable workforce training.
abstract_zh: 背景:初级卫生保健(PHC)护士在登革热预防和管理中起着核心作用,但以讲座为主的培训可能无法有效吸引学习者。基于游戏的学习提供了一种互动替代方案,能够促进参与和技能强化。目的:评估登革热教育棋盘游戏在初级卫生保健护士中的可行性与可接受性。方法:在印度尼西亚的两个初级卫生保健单位进行了一项单臂前后可行性研究。该游戏基于国家登革热指南并由专家验证,整合了基于知识、基于病例和技能演示任务。通过招募、出勤率和完成率评估可行性。通过五点李克特量表和定性反馈测量可接受性。探索性结果包括知识、态度和信心的描述性总结。结果:可行性标准已达成,所有参与者均完全参与并完成游戏。可接受性评分很高,所有参与者都强烈同意该游戏令人愉快、相关且有助于知识和技能的提升。描述性分析显示,干预后知识(从4.0到6.0)、态度(从27.0到29.5)和信心(从18.5到21.5)的中位数得分呈现积极趋势。满意度也很高(中位数25.0,四分位距24.3–25.0)。结论:登革热棋盘游戏具有可行性和可接受性,支持在受控试验中进一步评估,以实现可扩展的卫生人员培训。

title: Secondary Analysis of Clinical Bulk RNA-Sequencing Samples from Dengue Virus-Infected Patients Reveals EGFR, mTOR, and VEGF-A as Potential Therapeutic Targets
abstract: Almost half of the human population lives in areas where dengue virus (DENV) is endemic and are at risk of infection. The aim of the current study was to analyze 65 publicly available bulk RNA-sequencing samples from the GEO NCBI database. We hypothesized that investigating gene expression in patients with DENV infection compared to healthy controls could identify potential therapeutic targets and augment our understanding of the intracellular transcriptomic response to DENV infection. We report various genes with significant differential expression and multiple predicted drug targets that could be repurposed to reduce the signs and symptoms associated with DENV infection.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为这些发现可以提供关于DENV感染细胞内转录组反应的见解,并提出潜在的治疗靶点。这是一种通过转录组分析识别药物靶点的新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为未来关于登革病毒感染治疗干预的研究提供信息,并有助于开发针对性的治疗。它们还可能增强我们对DENV感染分子机制的理解。

title: Diagnostic performance of artificial intelligence in early diagnosis of mosquito-borne viral infections: Systematic review and meta-analysis.
abstract: Early diagnosis of mosquito-borne viral infections is challenging because initial symptoms are often nonspecific and confirmatory testing may be delayed or unavailable. We synthesised evidence on artificial intelligence and machine learning models for the early diagnosis of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. We conducted a PRISMA 2020-compliant systematic review and meta-analysis (PROSPERO CRD420251129670). PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, and Scopus were searched from inception to 11 August 2025 for model-development or validation studies reporting diagnostic performance. Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), accuracy, positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV) were pooled using random-effects models, while sensitivity and specificity were jointly synthesised using a bivariate random-effects model. Risk of bias was assessed using the Prediction model Risk Of Bias Assessment Tool (PROBAST). Database searches identified 4,531 records, of which 43 studies met the inclusion criteria. The evidence was predominantly from Asia and overwhelmingly focused on dengue; no eligible studies evaluated West Nile virus, yellow fever, or Rift Valley fever. Pooled estimates were 0.954 (95% CI 0.936–0.968) for AUC, 0.904 (95% CI 0.888–0.918) for accuracy, 0.903 (95% CI 0.876–0.925) for PPV, and 0.882 (95% CI 0.859–0.902) for NPV. The bivariate pooled sensitivity was 0.861 (95% CI 0.809–0.900) and specificity was 0.902 (95% CI 0.871–0.927). Heterogeneity was substantial for the univariate outcomes (I 2 95.8%–97.7%). Most studies were at high overall risk of bias, while calibration and external validation were uncommon. Artificial intelligence models showed encouraging diagnostic performance in the published literature, but the pooled estimates should be interpreted as descriptive summaries of a highly heterogeneous evidence base rather than as definitive estimates of real-world performance. Prospective, externally validated, well-calibrated, and geographically diverse studies are needed before routine clinical implementation can be recommended.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluates the diagnostic performance of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning models for the early diagnosis of mosquito-borne viral infections, specifically focusing on dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. The review identified 43 studies from PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, and Scopus, with a pooled AUC of 0.954 (95% CI 0.936–0.968), accuracy of 0.904 (95% CI 0.888–0.918), PPV of 0.903 (95% CI 0.876–0.925), and NPV of 0.882 (95% CI 0.859–0.902). Sensitivity and specificity were pooled at 0.861 (95% CI 0.809–0.900) and 0.902 (95% CI 0.871–0.927), respectively. However, the evidence base is highly heterogeneous, with substantial I2 values for univariate outcomes. Most studies were at high risk of bias, and external validation was rare. The review highlights the need for more robust, geographically diverse, and well-calibrated studies before AI models can be recommended for routine clinical use.
